title: C# Questions & Answers - Reading Console Input Operations
sourceFile: Reading Console Input Operations - C# Questions & Answers - Sanfoundry.html
description: This section of our 1000+ C# multiple choice questions focuses on reading console input operations in C# Programming Language.

questions.question: Name the exception thrown by read() on failure.
questions.explanation: read() throws I/O exception on failure.

questions.question: Which of these methods are used to read single character from the console?
Which of these method used to read strings from the console?
Which among the following methods are used to write characters to a string?
questions.explanation: The stream class method writes characters to the string.

questions.question: Which method in Console enables to read individual inputs directly from the keyboard in a non line buffered manner?
questions.explanation: The .NET Framework includes a method in Console that enables you to read individual keystrokes directly from the keyboard, in a non-line-buffered manner. This method is called ReadKey(). When it is called, it waits until a key is pressed. When the key is pressed, ReadKey( ) returns the keystroke immediately.

questions.question: What is the output returned by Console if ReadLine() stores I/O error?
What will be the output for following input from the console as a character?

options.text: Code run successfully prints nothing on console
Code runs successfully prints input on console

questions.explanation: Since only a single character is required to be entered on console when a string is entered, a run time exception is being generated as we had not used Read() which reads single character but used readLine() which reads string and is converted into the char using convert.tochar().

questions.question: Name the method/methods used to read byte streams from the file?
Which of these method/methods are used to read block or array of bytes from the file?
questions.explanation:
To read a block of bytes, use Read( ), which has this general form:

              int Read(byte[ ] array, int offset, int count).
